correctness.rationale: For fixed 1/2<p<=1 the invariant dyadic density gives J_m=E[X0 D^m(X0)]=mu/2+2^(-m)/12+B*c^m (checked independently by rational geometric sums at p=3/5,4/5,9/10 for m<=7). A random walk in doubling/halving decisions has exact identity X_n=2^(S_n-M_n)D^(M_n)X0; the reflected-height recurrence yields its generating resolvent Phi. Combining three modes and subtracting mu^2/(1-z) yields the stationary correlation generating function. Positive- and negative-edge square-root expansions and the t=1/2 physical-sheet pole determine the p<4/5, p=4/5 and p>4/5 fixed-parameter asymptotics. Independently enumerated exact walk probabilities and dyadic moments through lag 5 for three p; original packaged rational finite-lag verifier supplies further checks. No critical p=1/2 or uniform crossover theorem asserted.
